boards.prompt: High fidelity UI storyboard for Omkar Jawalikar's experiential portfolio. This is a BOARD OF SEPARATE PAGES, not sections of one homepage. Original coherent visual identity: warm ivory #F4F1E9, deep plum ink #302538, dusty violet #7761A8, soft apricot #EDB78D. Dark theme charcoal-plum #211D27 with ivory text and same muted accents. Contemporary friendly heavy sans typography with slightly rounded shapes, no serif, clear readable text, generous negative space, restrained playful details. Thin outlines, mostly square controls with 10px radius, no rainbow word blocks, no folder cards, no giant name header, no dashboard. Shared header: tiny monochrome scribbled cat on a short track at left with tiny Play triangle (the cat is a CONCEPT placeholder), text navigation Home / About / Journey / Projects / Now / Contact, theme icon at right. On mobile header only cat/play, theme icon and Menu. Never put owner's name in header. Clear page progression small 'Previous' and 'Next' at bottom. No fake metrics, awards, unknown school names, made-up personal preferences, fictional screenshots or AI twin controls. The cat game is optional, no content unlocking gates. Render legible exact major labels and only the short provided copy. Entire frame content must fit and margins be generous. Outside page frames put numbered state captions and one-line interaction captions. Small board footer 'DESIGN STORYBOARD · interactions illustrated, not running'.  Board 1: DESKTOP / MEET OMKAR. Landscape image, four equally sized large desktop webpage frames in a 2x2 arrangement, each frame 16:10 aspect ratio. 01 ENTRANCE light theme: only a small centrally placed scribbled cat drawn halfway and text 'Getting things ready…'; no percent bar, no header yet. Outside caption 'Essential assets ready → cat settles into header'. 02 LANDING light theme: header; spacious asymmetric hero with large 'Hi, I’m Omkar.' and smaller 'Software engineer. Curious about the work, and the world around it.' two clear buttons 'Meet me' and 'Explore my journey'; a large subtle abstract curved path on right with a few small dots suggesting travel, not a diagram or copied illustration, no content grid or project list. Outside caption 'Choose a chapter. Explore at your pace.' 03 ABOUT light theme: header with About selected. Title 'A little beyond work.' Short copy 'Some things I enjoy. Some things we could talk about.' Four widely spaced readable entries in two rows, standard simple icons and labels 'Music & dance', 'Cars', 'Sports', 'Stories'; no details initially. Outside caption 'Select one interest to open its view'. 04 MUSIC dark theme: header About selected; '← Back to About'; title 'A little of my music taste.' Two large plain typographic artist entries 'Martin Garrix' and 'Arijit Singh'; smaller 'Music & dance'; no album art or playback controls, no fake connected service. A muted apricot button 'Exchange a playlist →' and helper 'Spotify or Apple Music links welcome.' Outside caption 'Playlist invitation opens Contact; no account connection'.

Board 2: DESKTOP / JOURNEY TO CONNECTION. Landscape image four large equal desktop webpage frames arranged 2x2, each frame 16:10. All four DARK theme with coherent light accents. 05 JOURNEY: header Journey selected, small segmented switch 'Journey | Projects'; title 'The dots so far.' A spacious read-only connected path across left two thirds with labeled milestone dots '2004 / Born', 'School / Details to add', 'VIT / Computer science', 'Experience', 'Now / Anarock', dashed tail 'Next / Still becoming'. Do not invent schooling years. Now dot selected and right detail panel reads 'Anarock', 'Software Engineer I', 'Current chapter', small 'Role details to verify'. Small text alternative link 'Read as a timeline'. Outside caption 'Select a dot → its story opens; dashed future is aspiration'. 06 PROJECTS: header Projects selected; same Journey | Projects switch; title 'A wall of things I’ve built.' Horizontal carousel, one dominant wide card 'Saathi' 'A collaborative workspace' with an elegant typographic cover 'Shared work. Connected updates.' and small 'Concept cover'; glimpse of next card 'AtlasPay' 'Payment workflows'. Simple visible Previous / Next arrows and '1 / 3'. Main action 'Open project'. Do not show fake product screenshot or diagram. Outside caption 'Swipe or arrows → open a story → return to same position'. 07 NOW: header Now selected, title 'What has my attention.' Three calm spaced editorial rows 'Building / Latest update to add', 'Writing / Read my articles ↗', 'Sharing / LinkedIn posts ↗'. A small optional footer 'Listening / Martin Garrix · Arijit Singh'. No invented dates, fake posts or “live” status. Outside caption 'Curated, dated updates; source links work without feeds'. 08 CONTACT light theme: same header Contact selected, huge friendly 'Let’s talk.' Short 'About a project, an idea, or a playlist.' Primary text link 'Email me ↗', secondary 'LinkedIn ↗' 'GitHub ↗'; small 'Résumé ↗'. No form, no fake email address. Outside caption 'A simple end to the tour—and an easy place to return'.

details: undefined Board 5: INTERACTION DETAILS. Four clearly distinct panels in 2x2 landscape board. 09 CAT HEADER: light page partial, three stacked little strips labeled 'Idle / Play', 'Playing / Jump / Pause', 'Paused / Resume / Exit'. Each strip shows SAME tiny monochrome scribbled cat on short horizontal track, with plain buttons. Small fourth line 'Finished → Try again or Exit'. Caption 'Optional play. Page navigation remains available.' No game scores or claim of functioning code. 10 PROJECT STORY dark desktop screen: shared header with Projects selected; prominent '← Back to the wall'; title 'Saathi'; subtitle 'A collaborative workspace'; large typographic concept cover 'Shared work. Connected updates.' marked 'Concept cover'. Below three clear accordion labels 'The idea', 'My contribution', 'Decisions & evidence', only 'The idea' open with short exact text 'A place to organize shared work.' Footer 'View source ↗'. Caption 'Back restores the selected card; evidence content comes from verified work'. 11 MOBILE MENU dark tall mobile viewport at left within panel, light mobile music/contact handoff mini viewport at right: menu has cat at top left and Close top right, labels Home About Journey Projects Now Contact, secondary Resume, Light / Dark / System control bottom. Handoff mini frame title 'Let’s talk.' small context 'About a playlist' and 'Email me ↗' action. Caption 'Menu closes on selection; Escape returns focus'. 12 THEME PAIR: two matching small landing desktop frames side by side showing identical layout in light and dark; same cat header, heading 'Hi, I’m Omkar.', short intro and buttons Meet me / Explore my journey. Caption 'Same layout and content. Surfaces and ink adapt.' No copied website assets; neutral professional playfulness. This sheet illustrates UI states only.
